title: Quiz 1 — Earth's Uniqueness & Greenhouse Effect
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: What are the two most abundant gases in Earth's atmosphere?
options: Nitrogen and oxygen
Oxygen and carbon dioxide
Hydrogen and helium gas
Carbon dioxide and methane
questions.correct: Nitrogen and oxygen

questions.text: Which layer of gas absorbs most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation?
options: Ozone layer
Ionosphere
Troposphere
Cloud layer
questions.correct: Ozone layer

questions.text: Why is Earth's distance from the Sun important for life?
options: It keeps water liquid on the surface
It makes Earth spin faster each day
It gives Earth a very thick atmosphere
It keeps all of Earth's water frozen solid
questions.correct: It keeps water liquid on the surface

questions.text: What does Earth's magnetic field protect us from?
options: Charged particles of the solar wind
Meteors and small falling asteroids
Visible light coming from the Sun
Strong winds during the typhoons
questions.correct: Charged particles of the solar wind

questions.text: Why can Mercury NOT support liquid water even though it gets lots of sunlight?
options: It has almost no atmosphere to hold heat or water
It is the planet farthest from the Sun in the system
It has a thick ice shell that blocks all sunlight
It has too many oceans and is too wet for life
questions.correct: It has almost no atmosphere to hold heat or water

questions.text: Which property of water keeps coastal climates mild?
options: It heats and cools slowly
It freezes at a high temperature
It reflects all sunlight away
It dissolves salt from rocks
questions.correct: It heats and cools slowly

questions.text: Which planet is the hottest in the Solar System?
options: Venus
Mercury
Mars
Jupiter
questions.correct: Venus

questions.text: Scientists find a planet in its star's habitable zone with a thick atmosphere and liquid water. Which next step is MOST useful for judging if life is possible?
options: Check for energy sources and life-friendly chemistry
Measure how many moons orbit the planet during each year
Count how many stars are visible in its night sky
Find out the color of the planet seen from far away
questions.correct: Check for energy sources and life-friendly chemistry

questions.text: Venus is closer to the Sun than Earth, and Mercury is closer still, yet Venus is hotter than Mercury. What does this show?
options: Atmosphere can matter more than distance for temperature
Distance from the Sun is the only factor that ever matters
Planets closer to the Sun are always the coolest ones
Mercury must have a thicker atmosphere than Venus
questions.correct: Atmosphere can matter more than distance for temperature

questions.text: A student claims, "Mars could easily support humans today because it once had rivers." Which judgment is BEST?
options: Weak — Mars today is too cold, thin-aired and unprotected
Strong — any planet with past rivers can support humans now
Strong — Mars has the same atmosphere as Earth now
Weak — because Mars has never had any water at all
questions.correct: Weak — Mars today is too cold, thin-aired and unprotected

questions.text: What kind of radiation does Earth's surface give off as heat?
options: Infrared
Ultraviolet
X-rays
Radio waves
questions.correct: Infrared

questions.text: Which gas is the main driver of recent human-caused warming?
options: Carbon dioxide
Oxygen gas
Nitrogen gas
Argon gas (Ar)
questions.correct: Carbon dioxide

questions.text: What is albedo?
options: The share of sunlight a surface reflects
The heat stored deep in the oceans
The amount of rain falling on land per year
The speed of winds in the atmosphere
questions.correct: The share of sunlight a surface reflects

questions.text: Without the natural greenhouse effect, Earth's average temperature would be about…
Which human activity releases methane?
options: Livestock and flooded rice fields
Using solar panels on all the rooftops
Planting mangroves on the coast
Riding bicycles to school daily
questions.correct: Livestock and flooded rice fields

questions.text: How is the ENHANCED greenhouse effect different from the natural one?
options: It is extra warming from human-added gases
It is the cooling caused by more clouds
It only happens on other planets today, not Earth
It is caused by the ozone layer thinning
questions.correct: It is extra warming from human-added gases

questions.text: Why does melting sea ice speed up warming?
options: Dark water absorbs more sunlight than ice
Melting ice releases large amounts of heat
Ice water adds carbon dioxide to the air
Melting ice makes the Sun shine brighter
questions.correct: Dark water absorbs more sunlight than ice

questions.text: A town replaces 1,000 old aircons with efficient inverter units. How does this reduce warming?
options: Less electricity used means less CO₂ from power plants
Inverter aircons remove CO₂ directly from the outside air
Efficient aircons make the room's air denser and colder
Inverter aircons block sunlight from entering the houses
questions.correct: Less electricity used means less CO₂ from power plants

questions.text: Graphs show atmospheric CO₂ and global temperature both rising since 1900. Which conclusion is BEST supported by greenhouse science?
options: More CO₂ traps more heat, adding to the warming
Higher temperatures are caused by a much brighter Moon
CO₂ has no connection to temperature at all
Warming is caused only by more sunlight reflection
questions.correct: More CO₂ traps more heat, adding to the warming

questions.text: Why does the Philippines feel strong climate impacts even though it emits only a small share of global CO₂?
options: Greenhouse gases mix globally, warming the whole planet
The country's own emissions stay above its own islands only
Typhoons are caused only by local emissions
Climate change affects only the countries that emit
questions.correct: Greenhouse gases mix globally, warming the whole planet
